caseName: Standard Pipe Line Company, Inc. v. Commissioners of Index Sulphur Drainage District
caseNameFull: Standard Pipe Line Company, Inc., Et Al. v. Commissioners of Index Sulphur Drainage District
attorneys: Messrs. William H. Arnold and David C. Arnold for petitioners., Mr. Henry Moore, Jr., for respondents.

opinions.text:
*558 Per Curiam:

The writ of certiorari is dismissed for.the' reason that the decree Of the state court sought here to be reviewed was based on a nonfederal ground adequate to support it. Bilby v. Stewart, 246 U. S. 255, 257; Farson, Son & Co. v. Bird, 248 U. S. 268, 271.

*559 Mr. Henry Moore, Jr., for respondents.
